summary: Pulsenmore Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq/TASE, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 13, 2026, announcing the appointment of David Woods as Chief Commercial Officer and expansion of its U.S. commercial team. No transaction terms, stake percentages, prices, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are disclosed. The filing is a routine commercial-leadership announcement accompanying U.S. growth efforts tied to FDA De Novo authorization and exploration of the federal Rural Health Transformation Program. Not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
